headline: Occidental Names Brad Pollack Senior Vice President and General Counsel
summary: HOUSTON, July 31, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Occidental (NYSE: OXY) announced today that Brad Pollack has been appointed Senior Vice President and General Counsel, effective August 1, 2026, overseeing the company’s global legal department.
